title: dpk.yaml
description: Configuration for dpk, a package manager for Dart that adds scripts, hooks, workspace catalogs, and dependency patches to dart pub.

version.description: The dpk versions this project works with, as a version constraint such as ^1.0.0. dpk refuses to run when the installed version is outside it.

mode.description: Where pub stores packages. "global" uses the global pub cache. "project" uses a project cache so dependencies can be patched; use it only when you patch dependencies.

sort_pubspec.description: Sort the keys and dependencies of every pubspec on dpk get.

workspace.description: Globs that select workspace packages. Matching directories whose pubspec has resolution: workspace are written to the root pubspec's workspace list on dpk get.

cache_dir.description: The project cache directory, relative to the workspace root. Only used in project mode.

patch_dir.description: The directory for patch files, relative to the workspace root.

scripts.description: Scripts run with dpk run <name>. Names starting with pre: or post:, and the names before and after, are hooks.

command.description: The shell command to run. It runs in /bin/sh, or cmd.exe on Windows.

description.description: Shown by dpk run when it lists the scripts.

run_in_packages.description: Workspace packages to run in, by name or by a glob over their paths. Use . for the workspace root.

run_hooks_from.description: Also run the hooks of this script or command.

scripts.description: For the before and after hooks: the scripts and commands they run around.

all.description: For the before and after hooks: run around every script and command.

concurrency.description: The most workspace packages to run in at once.

fail_fast.description: Stop the remaining packages when one fails.

dependency_order.description: Start a package only after the workspace packages it depends on have finished.

dependency.description: A version constraint, or a dependency mapping such as {git: {url: ...}}, written to pubspecs as given.

catalog.description: Shared settings that dpk get applies to the workspace root and workspace packages.

environment.description: SDK constraints, merged key by key into each pubspec's environment.

version.description: The version for every workspace package.

publish_to.description: publish_to for every workspace package, such as none.

topics.description: Topics added to every workspace package. Existing topics are kept.

funding.description: Funding URLs. Support the DPK_PACKAGE_* variables.

platforms.description: The platforms map for every workspace package.

dependencies.description: Versions for dependencies and dev_dependencies that packages already have.

dependency_overrides.description: Overrides written to the workspace root pubspec.
